features: 【130° Ultra-wide Field of Coverage】: Covers 130° field of view through ultra-wide lens FoV, providing extended coverage.
【4MP Ultra 2K Display (2560x1440)】: Delivers crystal clear video footage for outdoor monitoring in all lighting conditions.
【NightPulse Color Night Vision】: Equipped with high-performance IR LEDs for colored, sharp, and clear visibility in complete darkness.
【Spotlight, Siren & Motion Tracking】: Protect what matters by scaring off intruders with spotlight & siren and tracking movements with motion tracking.

【AI Person Detection & Alerts】: Advanced AI detects motion and distinguishes humans to minimize false alerts. Instant smart notifications are sent to your Qubo App, and the system can trigger spotlight & a loud intruder alarm.
【Two-Way Talk With Noise Reduction】: Built-in speaker and noise-reducing microphone allow you to communicate clearly with visitors & family — no matter where you are.
【Dual Antenna, IP66 Weatherproof】: Built with dual antenna for connectivity beyond exterior walls. In-app Wi-Fi signal strength display. Suitable for outdoor installation in rain, heat, and dust.

【Cloud Storage & SD Card Support】: Supports storage on secure & reliable Indian cloud without requiring an SD Card, with cost-effective plans starting from Rs. 99/month (2 devices). Supports 24x7 continuous recording locally with up to 1TB microSD card.
【Never Miss an Alert】: Call alerts, international alerts, and simultaneous alerting of 3+ users included with cost-effective plans starting from Rs. 99/month.
【A Hero Group Venture - Made in India, for Indian Homes】: Designed, built, and manufactured in India to help customers protect what matters most to them.
